question: Explain CSS3 Flexbox with its key container and item properties.
points: Flexbox provides a one-dimensional layout model for aligning items efficiently across rows or columns.
display: flex activates the flex container context.
flex-direction defines the main axis (row, column, row-reverse, column-reverse).
justify-content aligns flex items along the main axis, while align-items aligns along the cross axis.

question: Differentiate between On-Page SEO and Off-Page SEO.
points: On-Page SEO optimizes elements directly on the website (title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structure).
Off-Page SEO focuses on external authority signals such as backlinks and brand mentions.
On-Page includes technical site performance, valid HTML, and image alt tags.
Off-Page relies on external reputation building and social bookmarking.

question: Explain event handling in JavaScript with an example.
points: An event is an action or occurrence recognized by software, such as mouse clicks or key presses.
Event handlers are JavaScript functions executed when a specific event is triggered.
Common DOM events include onclick, onmouseover, onsubmit, and onload.
Event listeners can be attached using element.addEventListener('click', handlerFunction).
